How are the Tales games by the way? Are they all pretty much the same?
Pretty much all the same, yeah. They're interactive stories, mostly. My boyfriend loves them, but I can't stand them. Walking around making dialog choices just isn't that fun to me.

Much like Final Fantasy, each flagship title is set in a different world with a new cast of heroes and villains. There are common themes shared between the titles, a catastrophe to avert, history repeating itself, will we ever learn, that kind of thing.

For me what keeps each Tales game fresh is that the combat system is different in each flagship title. It's all real time combat, but each game will put in a unique twist to spice things up, such as Graces CC gauge replacing Mana to enable fast, hectic combat, or Xillia's Link System, where you can form a link with a partner in combat and gain certain boosts and abilities while the link is active.
